summary: Tahap 1B (Customer Management) end-to-end tested. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed (list+search+filter+sort+pagination, CRUD, validation, RBAC viewer, multi-tenant isolation, cross-tenant 404, per-tenant counter, audit log with old/new data). Frontend: all major flows work — page renders, add customer + auto CUS-XXXXXX code, edit with readonly code, deactivate with confirmation dialog and soft-delete, detail dialog with Rp 0 summary placeholder, server-side search + empty-state, RBAC hides write buttons for viewer, ownerb only sees tenant B data, mobile viewport shows customer-cards (table hidden), audit log page shows Pelanggan Dibuat/Diperbarui/Dinonaktifkan entries. No regressions on Tahap 1A auth/users/security.

ui_bugs.issue: Empty-name and invalid-email validation currently relies on HTML5 native validation (input required, type=email) rather than the JS-level app validator (which does exist and correctly renders customer-form-error). If a screen reader or automation bypasses HTML5 (or a user pastes invalid email into a browser that skips HTML5), only the app-level error appears. Native HTML5 popup is not styled and is in English by browser locale. Consider adding noValidate to the form and letting the existing JS validator + backend 422 handling render the inline customer-form-error consistently in Indonesian.

action_items: Optional (LOW): switch CustomerFormDialog form to noValidate so the existing JS validator (already writing to customer-form-error) is the single source of truth for validation UX; keep required for accessibility but ensure Indonesian error messaging is always visible via the inline banner.

Nice-to-have: on server 422 (e.g. invalid email/phone caught by Pydantic), current code sets customer-form-error via formatApiErrorDetail — verify that error branch surfaces detail correctly (backend test proves the 422 is returned; UI already reads err.response.data.detail so it works).
critical_code_review_comments: Customer list uses a regex-based $or search with re.escape — safe from ReDoS-style injection but not indexed; adequate for MVP scale but consider text index in Tahap 2 as data grows.
get_tenant_customer correctly returns 404 for both malformed ObjectId and other-tenant ID — hides existence (correct behavior).
Deactivate endpoint returns early (no log entry) when customer is already inactive — acceptable idempotency but consider logging a no-op audit entry for compliance/traceability.
server.py is now ~800 lines. Recommend splitting into routers/ (auth, users, customers, security) plus a shared deps/models module before Tahap 2 to keep review-ability.
CustomersPage.jsx (~500 lines) mixes 3 sub-components. Consider extracting CustomerFormDialog & CustomerDetailDialog to /components/customers/*.
